items.source: Package an application into an OCI image using a buildpack, but without forking the lifecycle. This goal should be used when configuring a goal execution in your build. To invoke the goal on the command-line, use build-image instead.
items.translation: 使用构建包将应用程序打包为 OCI 镜像，但不分叉生命周期。在配置构建中的目标 `execution` 时，应使用此目标。要在命令行中调用该目标，请使用 `build-image`。
